userStories.title: Fixed header and the three tabs
userStories.description: PRD 'Header' and 'Removed from the app'. Tabs become Home (list.bullet -> house), Analysis (chart.bar), Protocol (pills); Calendar tab removed. Every tab's toolbar: status pill (battery % when known, eyeglasses symbol ink/muted for worn-or-connected/off, dot + ConnectionStatus text), Start watching / Stop (.glassProminent, the only one on screen, disabled until ConnectRows.canStart, consent gate as today), Preview button (camera.viewfinder, .glass, disabled unless glasses connected; opens an empty placeholder sheet until D-002), Settings gear. GlassesSessioning gains deviceState (batteryLevel, charging, worn) + onDeviceStateChange; GlassesSession implements it with Wearables.shared.deviceForIdentifier + addDeviceStateListener; MockGlasses and demo report 82% worn; -glassesOff reports nil. AppScreen ids: home, analysis, protocol, connect, settings, preview ('today' alias of home). Today's floating Stop button and old pill placement go; TodayView becomes HomeView (content unchanged for now).
acceptanceCriteria: Tab bar shows exactly Home, Analysis, Protocol
Header on every tab shows battery, glasses symbol, status text, Start/Stop, Preview, gear; it stays while the page scrolls
HeaderState.derive (pure) has tests for: unknown battery, glasses off, worn, watching
Screenshots D-001-home.png, D-001-protocol.png, D-001-home-glassesoff.png
Build and tests exit 0
